code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, leukopenia with neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated RDW, and mild anemia. There is a left shift in white cell differential (monocytosis, basophilia), elevated ferritin, LDH, and CRP, suggesting inflammation or possible infection. Mild hypoproteinemia is present. Coagulation parameters are within therapeutic range for anticoagulation. The findings are concerning for acute or chronic inflammatory/infectious process, possible bone marrow suppression, and impaired oxygenation; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
